name: Iketsuchi Shii
source:
C is a student council member in her senior year at B's old high school. She is quite sensitive to other people's opinions, constantly trying to conform to conventional beauty standards and her peers. She wasn’t always like this however - just one year prior, she was openly obsessed with aliens and joined the Occult Club, a group of misfits drawn together by their passion for the unknown. C was dragged around by A with B to perform miscellaneous pranks on unsuspecting victims. Wherever they were, there she was, listening to orders and supporting them in their hijinks. Now that A and B are graduated, she is focused more than ever on wearing her mask.

She is also a health nut who has a habit of nagging people regarding their nutritional decisions. Her family runs a small grocer in the city, so she has ready access to all sorts of vegetables and fruit. Ironically, she is as frail as a sheet of paper due in part to being plagued by genetic vitamin deficiencies. She has trouble even peeling an orange.

Her favourite foods are beef bowls and milk, though she wouldn't admit that to a boy.
